name: dftracer_install
description: Install dftracer into a session after the app built: the pre-release with dftracer-modules composed (dftracer-compose) against the app's MPI/HDF5/ROCm, or a pip/source build; prebuilt wheel search/retire, dftracer-utils install, dftracer.pc generation; validator dftracer_install_check (one core, layers linked, header, pkg-config, import). Load on 'Build the original app first', 'dftracer-compose did not link', 'CMake 3.24 or higher is required', 'GLIBCXX_3.4.30 not found', 'DFTracer was enabled but not available', NoOpProfiler, 'double free or corruption (!prev)', 'libmodules.so.1: cannot open shared object file', 'zlib_name_mangling.h file not found', two libdftracer_core copies, or an empty trace after a clean install.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents session_install_dftracer, dftracer_wheelhouse, session_install_dftracer_utils (register_session_tools) and session_generate_dftracer_pc (register_install_session_tools), skills dftracer-install and dftracer-build-dftracer, agent dftracer-build-dftracer
